title: Delinquency, Credit Bureau Reporting and Charge-Off of Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
**Collections standard — Home Comfort Financing.**

**Days past due.** Days past due are counted from the day after the due date of the oldest required payment still unpaid, as calendar days elapsed up to the date of handling; the count is 0 when no required payment is unpaid.

**Delinquency.** An account becomes delinquent when that count reaches the plan's delinquency threshold.

**Credit reporting.** A late payment is reported to the credit bureaus when the count reaches the plan's credit-reporting threshold. A reported late payment stays reported because it was accurate.

**Cure.** A delinquent account returns to active on the day a payment brings every past-due amount, including fees, current.

**Charge-off.** A delinquent account is charged off only when its days past due reach the plan's charge-off threshold. The due day and the posting dates on the account's records decide the count.

**After charge-off.** A charged-off account is closed to new payments by Harbison and passed to the recovery unit of the servicing partner.

## Status path

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| active | delinquent | days past due reach the delinquency threshold |
| delinquent | active | a payment brings every past-due amount, fees included, current |
| delinquent | charged off | days past due reach the charge-off threshold |

## Counting — illustration (hypothetical dates, thresholds of 30 and 120 days)

The oldest unpaid required payment was due on 5 March. Day 1 is 6 March.

| Date of handling | Days past due | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 3 April | 29 | below 30: not yet delinquent, not yet reported |
| 4 April | 30 | reaches 30: delinquent; the late payment is reported |
| 2 July | 119 | delinquent; below 120 |
| 3 July | 120 | reaches 120: charged off |

## Basis Q&A

**The borrower brings the account current. Is the reported late payment withdrawn?** No. A reported late payment stays reported because it was accurate.

**Does paying the missed installments alone return a delinquent account to active?** The account returns to active on the day a payment brings every past-due amount current, fees included.
